title: Does the teacher's field of view matter? — three-arm verdict
summary: Pre-registered controlled study: co-visible-region teacher restriction is unnecessary (full-context teacher +2.96 pp [1.92, 3.99]); full-context teacher adaptation is the only contract beating the frozen anchor (+3.42 pp [2.40, 4.42]); the cross-domain cost is a content-level shift on a pre-existing confusable family. Gain and cost are two faces of the same low-margin reshaping.
